validator_role: AI validation only; not a data source authority or data owner

authority_boundary.statement: This artifact records validation failure only. It is not a source receipt, does not attest a production count, and must not be used to activate HeatZone.

acceptance_reconciliation.criterion: at least 200 authoritative eligible mature labels
acceptance_reconciliation.observed: latest authoritative count is 0; no replacement source-system readback supplied

acceptance_reconciliation.observed: no new source-system locator, immutable snapshot id, or row-level lineage supplied

acceptance_reconciliation.criterion: synthetic, fixture, auto-seeded, duplicate, immature, ownerless, stale, and unverifiable rows rejected

readback.source_system: authoritative system of record name and environment
readback.location: reviewer-accessible immutable relation, snapshot, or object locator
readback.dataset_sha256: SHA-256 of the canonical eligible dataset using a declared serialization and ordering

eligibility_replay.query: exact SQL or immutable query artifact selecting is_training_eligible rows
eligibility_replay.query_sha256: hash of the exact executed query
eligibility_replay.eligible_count: integer greater than or equal to 200
eligibility_replay.ordered_hash_query: exact row ordering and serialization used for dataset_sha256

reviewer_replay: Resolve every cited source artifact and verify its SHA-256 before using it as prior evidence.
Run the supplied eligibility query at the declared immutable snapshot/cutoff.
Reconcile raw, eligible, exclusion, duplicate, and mature counts; require eligible_count >= 200.
Recompute the ordered canonical dataset SHA-256 and compare it with the owner receipt.
Reject the full batch if any authority, lineage, maturity, freshness, ownership, deduplication, or reproducibility criterion fails.
Keep HeatZone governed-disabled unless the complete batch passes.
next_action: Human/Ops must publish the complete authoritative handback packet. Codex3 then re-audits every criterion and may hand off only the fully reconciled batch for review.
